description: This Java class 'ShortcutHelper' manages Android app shortcuts, including creating, updating, enabling, disabling, and fetching favicons for shortcuts. It interacts with the Android ShortcutManager API and handles shortcut refresh logic.

classes.name: ShortcutHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing Android app shortcuts, including creation, refresh, enable/disable, and favicon fetching.

methods.name: maybeRestoreAllDynamicShortcuts
methods.description: Checks if dynamic shortcuts exist; placeholder for restoring shortcuts.

methods.name: reportShortcutUsed
methods.description: Reports usage of a shortcut by ID.

methods.name: callShortcutManager
methods.description: Executes a ShortcutManager operation with error handling and rate-limiting feedback.

methods.name: getShortcuts
methods.description: Retrieves all mutable dynamic and pinned shortcuts, removing duplicates.

methods.name: refreshShortcuts
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes shortcuts if they are stale or forced.

methods.name: createShortcutForUrl
methods.description: Creates a ShortcutInfo object for a given URL.

methods.name: setSiteInformation
methods.description: Sets label and icon for a shortcut based on URL.

methods.name: setExtras
methods.description: Adds refresh timestamp to shortcut extras.
